g.text: qwen3-asr: precision ladder (1.7B flat within noise, 0.6B steep)

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: 20-file corpus, 30s window; 8bit is the default on both sizes. A rung replaces 8bit only if its paired CI lies wholly above zero: every 1.7B CI spans zero (a tie keeps the default), every lower 0.6B rung lies below it (8bit wins). Source: qwen3-asr.md.
